questions.questionTextHi: तेलुगु ऊपर दी गई किस भाषा(भाषाओं) को सरकार द्वारा ''शास्त्रीय भाषा'' घोषित किया गया है?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). Certain Indian Languages have been awarded the distinction of classical language for preservation advancement of old literary traditions. Till 2014, total 6 languages have been declared as classical language by the Government of India. Tamil in 2004, Sanskrit in 2005, Telugu and Kannada in 2008 and Malayalam in 2013 and Odiya was given status of classical language in 2014. Panchayati Raj and Community Development *Panchayati Raj is the system of democratic decentralisation. Its objective is to bring the development to grass root level. *There are provisions related to Panchayati Raj in part-IX from Article 243 to Act 243 (O) in the Indian-constitution. *16 New Articles in part-IX and 11th schedule was added in Indian constitution by the 73rd constitutional Amendment Act 1992. Total 29 subjects are mentioned in 11th schedule providing power to panchayats to make laws. *Panchayati Raj is a subject of state list. *The state legislature determines provisions related to the structure of panchayats. *The state legislature take decisions with respect to all matters relating to elections to the Panchayat. *It is conducted after every 5 year. *There is a provision to form Finance commission to review ﬁ nancial condition of panchayats. *'Gram Sabha, is formed by the people registered in electoral rolls of a village. *Article 40 of Indian constitution directs the state for organisation of village panchayats. *Balwant Rai Mehta committee recommended the establishment of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system at-Village level, Block level and District level. *Balwant Rai Mehta is called Architect of Panchayati Raj system. *The inauguration of Panchayati Raj system was done by Pt. Jawahar lal Nehru on 2nd October 1959 at Nagaur (Rajasthan). *Panchayati Raj institutions got constitutional status by 73rd constitutional Amendment Act. *Firstly Laxmi Mal Singhvi committee in 1986 and then P.K. Thungan committee in 1988 recommended panchayati Raj Institutions to be given constitutional status. *Earlier, Ashok Mehta committee, in 1977 proposed that some provisions of Panchayati Raj are capable to be kept in Indian constitution, so Government of India should think over it. *Due to collapse of the Janta Government no action could be taken on the recommendations of the Ashok Mehta Committee at the central Level. *So only the recommendations of Laxmi Mal Singhvi and P.K. Thungan committee are clearly accepted. *According to Article 243-D(3), women are given 1/3rd reservation at all levels of Panchayats. *The minimum age to become a member of Panchayat is 21 years. *74th constitutional amendment Act 1992 gives constitutional status to the urban local self-government. *By this Amendment Act a new part [part IX (A)] and 12th schedule was added into the constitution. *There are 8 types of local self-government which includes Municipal corporation, Municipality, Notiﬁ ed Area Committee, Town Area Committee, Cantonment Board, Township, Port trust and Special Purpose Agencies. *74th Amendment Act provides three types of municipalities. *This includes Municipal corporation, Municipal council and a Nagar Panchayat. *All the members of the municipality were elected by the people of that area directly. *The term of municipality is 5 years but it can be terminated earlier also. *State election commission has the right to direct, control and manage the election for the municipalities. *A Finance commission is constituted under article 243 (I) to review ﬁ nancial condition of municipalities. *A District Planning committee is constituted under Article 243 ZD (1) at District level to consolidate the plans prepared by the municipalities in the district and to draft a development plan for the district as a whole. *According to Article 243ZE, in every metropolitan area, a metropolitan planning committee is to be constituted, to prepare a draft development plan for the metropolitan area as a whole. *In India the ﬁ rst municipal corporation was established in Madras in the year 1688. *Lord Ripon is known as the father of local self-government in India. 1. Who among the following is authorized to make provisions with respect to the composition of Panchayats? (a) Governor of State (b) Legislature of State (c) Parliament of India (d) President of India U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (b) According to Article 243-C(1) of the Indian Constitution, the legislature of a state may, by law make provision on the composition of Panchayat. 2. The nomenclature of rural local governments as 'Pan- chayati Raj' was the result of the suggestion of which Indian leader? (a) Jawaharlal Nehru (b) Dr. Rajendra Prasad (c) Sardar Patel (d) M. K. Gandhi U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2017 Ans. (d) Mahatma Gandhi suggested the nomenclature of rural local governments as 'Panchayati Raj'. He wanted to see each village a little republic, self-suﬃ cient in its vital wants and enjoying the maximum freedom of deciding the aﬀ airs of the locality. 3. What is not correct about Gram Panchayat? i. The maximum strength is 20 panchs in a Gram Panchayat. ii. If 15 panchs are elected in Gram Panchayat, then 5 panchs are nominated. iii. The President of Janpad Panchayat nominates 5 panchs. iv. The strength may be 10 panchs in a Gram Panchayat. v . In case of equal votes in the election of panchs it is decided by lott. vi. Nominated members participate in the meeting and can vote. Code : (a) i iv vi (b) iii v vi (c) ii iii vi (d) iv v vi (e) None of these Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (c) Gram Panchayats are the smallest unit of local self- governance, at village level. According to Chhattisgarh Panchayati Raj Act, (1993), each Gram Panchayat area is divided into not less than 10 and not more than 20 wards and each ward elects one Panch. The Gram Panchayat consists of the elected Panchs plus a Sarpanch who is the head of the Gram Panchayat. Thus all member are elected not nominated. So option (ii), (iii) and (vi) are wrong.

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements - 1. Part IX of the Constitution of India provisions for Panchayats and it was inserted by the Constitution (Amendment) Act, 1992. 2. Part IX-A of the Constitution of India contains provisions for municipalities, and the Article 243-Q envisages two types of municipalities- a Municipal Council and a Municipal Corporation for every State. Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct ?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें - 1. भारत के संविधान के भाग IX में पंचायतों के लिए प्रावधान हैं और इसे संविधान (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1992 द्वारा डाला गया था। 2. भारत के संविधान के भाग IX-A में नगर पालिकाओं के लिए प्रावधान हैं, और अनुच्छेद 243-Q में दो प्रकार की नगर पालिकाओं की परिकल्पना की गई है- प्रत्येक राज्य के लिए एक नगर परिषद और एक नगर निगम। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). Among the given statements, statement (1) is correct but (2) is incorrect. Reasons are as follows: 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 came into force on 24 April, 1993 after the ratiﬁ cation of the required number of States, provided a Constitutional guarantee for the formation of Panchayats, inserted Part IX and the 11th Schedule in the Constitution. It is correct that Part IX-A of the Constitution of India contains provisions for municipalities, but Article 243Q envisages 3 types (not 2 types) of municipalities: 1. Nagar Panchayats. 2. A Municipal Council for Smaller Urban Areas. 3. A Municipal Corporation for a Large Urban Areas.

questions.questionTextEn: In the areas covered under the Panchayat (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996, what is the role/ power of Gram Sabha? 1. Gram Sabha has the power to stop transfer of land in scheduled areas. 2. Gram Sabha has the ownership of minor forest produce. 3. Recommendation of Gram Sabha is required for granting prospecting license or mining lease for any mineral in the Scheduled Areas. Which of the statement(s) given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: पंचायत (अनुसूचित क्षेत्रों तक विस्तार) अधिनियम, 1996 के अंतर्गत आने वाले क्षेत्रों में ग्राम सभा की क्या भूमिका/शक्ति है? 1. ग्राम सभा को अनुसूचित क्षेत्रों में भूमि हस्तांतरण रोकने की शक्ति है। 2. लघु वन उपज का स्वामित्व ग्राम सभा के पास होता है। 3. अनुसूचित क्षेत्रों में किसी भी खनिज के लिए पूर्वेक्षण लाइसेंस या खनन पट्टा देने के लिए ग्राम सभा की सिफारिश आवश्यक है। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). In areas covered under the Panchayat (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 Gram Sabha has the ownership of minor forest produce and has power to ban transfer of land. It’s consent is necessary for issuing licenses/mining lease for minor minerals. However, in the case of other minerals, the recommendation of Gram Sabha is not required in Scheduled areas.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (B) In areas covered under the Panchayat (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 Gram Sabha has the ownership of minor forest produce and has power to ban transfer of land. It’s consent is necessary for issuing licenses/mining lease for minor minerals. However, in the case of other minerals, the recommendation of Gram Sabha is not required in Scheduled areas.

questions.questionTextEn: What is not correct about Gram Sabha? i. 1/10 Quorum is essential for the meeting of Gram Sabha. ii. The presence of 1/3 women is essential for the meeting of Gram Sabha. iii. Sarpanch and Panchs are responsible for Quorum. iv. The meeting of Gram Sabha can be adjourned in the absence of the Quorum. v. Quorum is essential in adjourned meeting. vi. The budget can be passed in the adjourned meeting where Quorum is not present. vii. The audit report can be passed in the adjourned meeting where Quorum is not present. viii. Sarpanch can be dismissed if Quorum is not present in ﬁ ve subsequent meetings of Gram Sabha. Choose the incorrect statements using the code given below. Code: A B C
questions.questionTextHi: ग्राम सभा के बारे में क्या सही नहीं है? मैं। 1/10 ग्राम सभा की बैठक के लिए कोरम आवश्यक है। द्वितीय. ग्राम सभा की बैठक में 1/3 महिलाओं की उपस्थिति आवश्यक है। iii. कोरम की जिम्मेदारी सरपंच और पंचों की होती है। iv. कोरम के अभाव में ग्राम सभा की बैठक स्थगित की जा सकती है। v. स्थगित बैठक में कोरम आवश्यक है। vi. बजट को स्थगित बैठक में पारित किया जा सकता है जहां कोरम मौजूद नहीं है। सातवीं. ऑडिट रिपोर्ट को स्थगित बैठक में पारित किया जा सकता है जहां कोरम मौजूद नहीं है। viii. ग्राम सभा की आगामी पांच बैठकों में कोरम उपस्थित न होने पर सरपंच को बर्खास्त किया जा सकता है। नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके गलत कथन चुनें। कोड: ए बी सी
optionsEn: v vi vii (e) vi vii viii
optionsHi: v vi vii (e) vi vii viii
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). According to Chhattisgarh Panchayati Raj Act 1993 as amended in 2004, a Gram Sabha must meet once every three months in a year. The presence of 1/10th of the total number of members of Gram Sabha of whom 1/3rd must be women, constitutes the quorum for a Gram Sabha meeting. The Sarpanch and Panchs shall be responsible for the quorum of the meeting of the Gram Sabha. Resolutions for the annual working plan, selection of beneﬁ ciaries, annual Budget, audit report and annual accounts and administrative report, shall be passed in the meeting which has a requisite quorum and in the case of absence of the quorum in ﬁ ve subsequent meetings of Gram Sabha, proceedings shall be initiated for the removal of Sarpanch. Thus, option (v), (vi) and (vii) are wrong.

questions.questionTextEn: What is the minimum population below, which at the intermediate level the Panchayats are not constituted as per provisions of the Indian Constitution (73rd Amendment Act)?
questions.questionTextHi: भारतीय संविधान (73वें संशोधन अधिनियम) के प्रावधानों के अनुसार मध्यवर्ती स्तर पर पंचायतों का गठन नहीं होने पर न्यूनतम जनसंख्या कितनी होती है?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The 73rd Amendment Act of 1992 has added a new Part-IX to the constitution of India, consisting of Provisions from Article 243 to 243(O). The Act has given a practical shape to Article 40 of the constitution. The act provides for a three tier system of Panchayati Raj in every state. However, a state having a population not excluding 20 lakh may not constitute panchayats at the intermediate level.

optionsEn: To instil non-conﬁ dence among local communities

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). Decentralization means delegation of authority to make decisions to the lowest possible organisational hierarchy level. questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following committees recommended ‘Three-Tier Panchayt Raj System’?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस समिति ने 'त्रि-स्तरीय पंचायत राज प्रणाली' की सिफारिश की?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). In January 1957, the Government of India appointed a Committee to examine the working of the Community Development Program (1952) and the National Extension Service (1953) and to suggest measures of their better working. The Chairman of this committee was Balwant Rai G Mehta. The committee submitted its report in November 1957 and recommended the establishment of the scheme of ‘Democratic decentralisation’ which came to be known as Panchayati Raj. It recommended a three tier system i.e Gram Panchayat at village level, panchayat samiti at the block Level and Zila Parishad at the district level.

questions.questionTextEn: Which model was recommended by Ashok Mehta Committee for Panchayati Raj System?
questions.questionTextHi: अशोक मेहता समिति ने पंचायती राज व्यवस्था के लिए किस मॉडल की सिफारिश की थी?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Ashoke Mehta committee was constituted in 1977, which submitted its report in August 1978. The committee in its report had recommended for ‘two tier’ system in place of ‘three tier’ system. The two- tier system or model was - Zila Parishad at the district level and Mandal Panchayat at the Mandal level which was consisted of a group of villages covering a population of 15000 to 20000.

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following Commtittees/Commissions recommended the creation of Nyaya Panchayats?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस समिति/आयोग ने न्याय पंचायतों के निर्माण की सिफारिश की?
optionsEn: Sarkaria Commission (e) None of the above / more than one of the above
optionsHi: सरकारिया आयोग (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं / उपरोक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Ashok Mehta Commitee (1978) recommended the Creation of Nyaya Panchayats. The Commitee recommended that Nyaya Panchayats should be kept as separate bodies and should not be mixed with the people elected for the devel- opment of Panchayats. The Commitee was in favour of a combination of a qualiﬁ ed Judge to preside over a bench of separately elected Nyaya Panches. The elected Nyaya Panches will not be entitled to seek re-election, they should serve in an area other than that from which they have been elected.

Prepares the electoral rolls for Panchayats and Municipalities elections in the State. 2. Conducts elections for Panchayats and Municipalities of the State. 3. Conducts elections for other bodies in addition to Panchayats and Municipalities in accordance with the directions given by the Governor. 4. Prepares the electoral rolls and conducts elections as assigned by Election Commission of India. Code :
questions.questionTextHi: राज्य चुनाव आयोग के निम्नलिखित कार्यों पर विचार करें और नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें? 1. राज्य में पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं के चुनावों के लिए मतदाता सूची तैयार करता है। 2. राज्य की पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं के लिए चुनाव आयोजित करता है। 3. राज्यपाल द्वारा दिए गए निर्देशों के अनुसार पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं के अलावा अन्य निकायों के लिए चुनाव आयोजित करता है। 4. भारत के चुनाव आयोग द्वारा सौंपे गए अनुसार मतदाता सूची तैयार करना और चुनाव कराना। कोड :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). According to Article 243-K(1) and 243-ZA(1), the superintendence, direction, and control of the preparation of electoral rolls and the conduct of all elections to the Panchayats and Municipalities shall be vested in State Election Commission.

questions.questionTextEn: The Constitution (Seventy-Third Amendment) Act, 1992, which aims at promoting the Panchayati Raj Institutions in the country, provides for which of the following? 1. Constitution of District Planning Committees. 2. Conducting all Panchayat elections by State Election Commissions. 3. Establishment of State Finance Commissions. Select the correct answer using the code given below: Code:
questions.questionTextHi: संविधान (तिहत्तरवाँ संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1992, जिसका उद्देश्य देश में पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को बढ़ावा देना है, निम्नलिखित में से किसके लिए प्रावधान करता है? 1. जिला योजना समितियों का गठन। 2. राज्य चुनाव आयोगों द्वारा सभी पंचायत चुनावों का संचालन करना। 3. राज्य वित्त आयोग की स्थापना। नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें: कोड:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). District Planning Committees are constituted under Article 243, ZD which was added by 74th Constitutional Amendments Act, 1992. It comes under Part IX-A of the Indian Constitution under the head ‘The Municipalities’. Provisions regarding State Election Commission to conduct all Panchayat Elections (Article 243 K) and establishment of State Finance Commission (Article 243-I) were added by 73rd Amendment Act,1992, to promote Panchayati Raj Institutions.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) District Planning Committees are constituted under Article 243, ZD which was added by 74th Constitutional Amendments Act, 1992. It comes under Part IX-A of the Indian Constitution under the head ‘The Municipalities’. Provisions regarding State Election Commission to conduct all Panchayat Elections (Article 243 K) and establishment of State Finance Commission (Article 243-I) were added by 73rd Amendment Act,1992, to promote Panchayati Raj Institutions.

optionsEn: Generation of gainful employment for the unemployed and the under-employed men and women in the rural area.
Generation of employment for the capable adults who are in need and desirous of works during the lean agricultural season.
Laying the foundation of strong and vibrant Panchayati Raj Institutions in the Country.
Guarantee of the right to life, liberty, and security of person equality before the law and equal protection without discrimination.

देश में मजबूत और जीवंत पंचायती राज संस्थाओं की नींव रखना।
जीवन, स्वतंत्रता और व्यक्ति की सुरक्षा के अधिकार की गारंटी, कानून के समक्ष समानता और बिना किसी भेदभाव के समान सुरक्षा।

questions.sectionTitleEn: 35. Panchayati Raj and Community Development — (ii) 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act (Rural Governance)
questions.sectionTitleHi: 35. पंचायती राज एवं सामुदायिक विकास (Panchayati Raj and Community Development) — (ii) 73वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम (ग्रामीण स्वशासन)
questions.topicTag: Indian Polity: 35. Panchayati Raj and Community Development — (ii) 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act (Rural Governance)
questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following was not proposed by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in context to Panchayati Raj?
questions.questionTextHi: पंचायती राज के संदर्भ में 73वें संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रस्तावित नहीं किया गया था?
optionsEn: Thirty percent seats to be reserved for women in all elected rural local bodies at all levels.
The States will constitute their Finance Commissions to allocate resources to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
The Panchayati Raj elected functionaries will be disqualiﬁ ed to hold their ofﬁ ces if they have more than two children.
The elections will be held in six months time if Panchayati Raj bodies are superseded or dissolved by the State Government.
optionsHi: सभी स्तरों पर सभी निर्वाचित ग्रामीण स्थानीय निकायों में महिलाओं के लिए तीस प्रतिशत सीटें आरक्षित की जाएंगी।
पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संसाधन आवंटित करने के लिए राज्य अपने वित्त आयोग का गठन करेंगे।
यदि पंचायती राज के निर्वाचित पदाधिकारियों के दो से अधिक बच्चे हैं तो वे अपना पद संभालने के लिए अयोग्य हो जाएंगे।
यदि राज्य सरकार द्वारा पंचायती राज निकायों को हटा दिया जाता है या भंग कर दिया जाता है तो छह महीने के भीतर चुनाव होंगे।
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). There are two options (a and c) in the question which were not proposed by 73rd Amendment. Reservation of seats for women is 1/3 to the total seats, not 30 percent and there is no such condition that an elected functionary will be disqualiﬁ ed to hold his ofﬁ ce if he has more than two children.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (A) There are two options (a and c) in the question which were not proposed by 73rd Amendment. Reservation of seats for women is 1/3 to the total seats, not 30 percent and there is no such condition that an elected functionary will be disqualiﬁ ed to hold his ofﬁ ce if he has more than two children.

questions.questionTextEn: With reference to Panchayats which of the statements is/are correct? 1. Fifty percent seats shall be reserved for the women of SC/ST categories. 2. Gram Sabha is a body consisting of all person living in the village. 3. There will be a Panchayat at intermediate level. Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
questions.questionTextHi: पंचायतों के संदर्भ में कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं? 1. एससी/एसटी वर्ग की महिलाओं के लिए 50 प्रतिशत सीटें आरक्षित रहेंगी. 2. ग्राम सभा एक ऐसी संस्था है जिसमें गांव में रहने वाले सभी लोग शामिल होते हैं। 3. मध्यवर्ती स्तर पर एक पंचायत होगी। नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). According to article 243 - "Gram Sabha" means a body con- sisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village comprised within the area of Panchayat at the village level. So, statement (2) is wrong. Article 243B(1) states that there shall be constituted in every state Panchayats at the village, intermediate and district lev- els in accordance with the provisions of this part. In Article 243B(2), Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population not exceeding 20 lakhs. So, statement (3) is correct. Article 243D, provides for not less than one-third of the total number of seats reserved for women belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes. So, statement (1) is incorrect. The correct option for the answer will be (d).
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (D) According to article 243 - "Gram Sabha" means a body con- sisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village comprised within the area of Panchayat at the village level. So, statement (2) is wrong. In Article 243B(2), Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population not exceeding 20 lakhs. So, statement (3) is correct. The correct option for the answer will be (d).

questions.topicTag: Indian Polity: 35. Panchayati Raj and Community Development — (ii) 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act (Rural Governance)
questions.questionTextEn: In the new Panchayati Raj Bill enacted in 1992, there are several new provisions different from the previous one. Which one of the following is not one such provision?
questions.questionTextHi: 1992 में अधिनियमित नये पंचायती राज विधेयक में पिछले विधेयक से भिन्न कई नये प्रावधान हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ऐसा प्रावधान नहीं है?
optionsEn: Some collective responsibilities in the area of agriculture, rural development, primary education and social forestry among others.
Elections being made mandatory for all posts on being vacant.
A statutory representation of women in the panchayats, up to one-third of the strength.
Regular remuneration to the panchayat members, so as to ensure their punctuality and accountability.
optionsHi: कृषि, ग्रामीण विकास, प्राथमिक शिक्षा और सामाजिक वानिकी के क्षेत्र में कुछ सामूहिक जिम्मेदारियाँ।
सभी पदों के रिक्त होने पर चुनाव अनिवार्य किया जा रहा है।
पंचायतों में महिलाओं का एक तिहाई संख्या तक वैधानिक प्रतिनिधित्व।
पंचायत सदस्यों को नियमित पारिश्रमिक देना, ताकि उनकी समय की पाबंदी और जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित की जा सके।
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). Regular remuneration is not one of the provisions made under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act. Rest of the provisions, mentioned in the question are part of the Panchayati Raj Bill 1992.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (D) Regular remuneration is not one of the provisions made under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act. Rest of the provisions, mentioned in the question are part of the Panchayati Raj Bill 1992.

questions.questionTextEn: What is the system of governance in the Panchayati Raj set up?
questions.questionTextHi: पंचायती राज व्यवस्था में शासन की व्यवस्था क्या है?
optionsEn: The single-tier structure of local self-government at the village level.
The two-tier system of local self-government at the village and block levels.
The three-tier structure of local self-government at the village, block and district levels.
The four-tier system of local self-government at the village block, district, and state levels.
optionsHi: ग्राम स्तर पर स्थानीय स्वशासन की एकल स्तरीय संरचना।
गाँव और ब्लॉक स्तर पर स्थानीय स्वशासन की द्विस्तरीय प्रणाली।
ग्राम, ब्लॉक और जिला स्तर पर स्थानीय स्वशासन की त्रिस्तरीय संरचना।
ग्राम ब्लॉक, जिला और राज्य स्तर पर स्थानीय स्वशासन की चार स्तरीय प्रणाली।
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). The Panchayati Raj set up is a three-tier structure (village, block and district level). However, Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population not exceeding twenty lakhs [Article 243 B(2)].
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) The Panchayati Raj set up is a three-tier structure (village, block and district level). However, Panchayats at the intermediate level may not be constituted in a state having a population not exceeding twenty lakhs [Article 243 B(2)].

optionsEn: The Vice President of Zilla Panchayat will be act as acting President
The Vice President will become President
The Ofﬁ ce of the President will be vacant
The members will elect President temporarily (e) None of the above

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements: 1. The minimum age prescribed for any person to be a member of Panchayat is 25 years. 2. A Panchayat reconstituted after premature dissolution continues only for the remainder period. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: 1. किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए पंचायत का सदस्य बनने के लिए निर्धारित न्यूनतम आयु 25 वर्ष है। 2. समय से पहले विघटन के बाद पुनर्गठित पंचायत केवल शेष अवधि के लिए जारी रहती है। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The minimum age to be a member of a Panchayat is 21 years. Thus statement (1) is not correct. While according to Article 243E a Panchayat constituted upon the dissolution of a Panchayat before the expiration of its duration shall continue only for the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayat would have continued. So statement (2) is correct.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (B) The minimum age to be a member of a Panchayat is 21 years. Thus statement (1) is not correct. While according to Article 243E a Panchayat constituted upon the dissolution of a Panchayat before the expiration of its duration shall continue only for the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayat would have continued. So statement (2) is correct.

questions.questionTextEn: What is the qualiﬁ cation to contest the election of Municipal Council? i. For the ofﬁ ce of the President, his age should not be less than 25 years. ii. For the ofﬁ ce of the councillor, his age should not be less than 21 years iii. Whose name is in the voter list, he can contest the election. iv. A person can contest the election of councillor from two wards simultaneously. v. A person can contest the election of president and councillor simultaneously. Code :
questions.questionTextHi: नगर परिषद का चुनाव लड़ने के लिए योग्यता क्या है? मैं। राष्ट्रपति पद के लिए उसकी आयु 25 वर्ष से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए। द्वितीय. iii.पार्षद पद के लिए उसकी आयु 21 वर्ष से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए। जिसका नाम वोटर लिस्ट में है, वही चुनाव लड़ सकता है. iv. एक व्यक्ति एक साथ दो वार्डों से पार्षद का चुनाव लड़ सकता है। v. कोई व्यक्ति अध्यक्ष एवं पार्षद का चुनाव एक साथ लड़ सकता है। कोड :
optionsEn: iii iv v (e) None of the above
optionsHi: iii iv v (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Section 34 of the Chhattisgarh Municipalities Act, 1961 provides that (1) A person who is enrolled in the Municipal Electoral Roll as a voter, shall be qualiﬁ ed to be a candidate: (a) for the election of President, if he is not less than twenty ﬁ ve years of age; and (b) for the election of Councillor, if he is not less than twenty one years of age. (2) No person who is a candidate for any one ward shall be a candidate for any other ward. (3) If a person is elected for the ofﬁ ce of President and Councillor both, he shall have to resign from one of the ofﬁ ces within seven days from the date on which he is declared to be elected.

(2) No person who is a candidate for any one ward shall be a candidate for any other ward. (3) If a person is elected for the ofﬁ ce of President and Councillor both, he shall have to resign from one of the ofﬁ ces within seven days from the date on which he is declared to be elected.

questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following statements regarding the 74th Amendment to the Constitution of India are correct? 1. It provides the insertion of a new Schedule to the Constitution. 2. It restructures the working of the Municipalities. 3. It provides the reservation of seats for women in Municipalities. 4. It is applicable only to some speciﬁ ed States. Select the correct answer from the codes given below: Codes :
questions.questionTextHi: भारत के संविधान के 74वें संशोधन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सही हैं? 1. यह संविधान में एक नई अनुसूची सम्मिलित करने का प्रावधान करता है। 2. यह नगर पालिकाओं के कामकाज का पुनर्गठन करता है। 3. यह नगर पालिकाओं में महिलाओं के लिए सीटों का आरक्षण प्रदान करता है। 4. यह केवल कुछ विशिष्ट राज्यों पर लागू है। नीचे दिए गए कोड से सही उत्तर चुनें: कोड:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). The Constitution (Seventy-fourth Amendment) Act, 1992 gave constitutional status to the municipalities. This Act has added a new Part IX-A, and consists of Provisions from Article 243 P to 243 ZG. In addition, the Act has also added a new 12th Schedule and 18 functional items of Municipalities. This act came into force on 1st June, 1993. Some of the characteristics of this act is as follows: 1. It provides for constitution of three type of municipalities - Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Council, Municipal Corporation. 2. The municipalities has a ﬁ xed term of 5 years from the date appointed for its ﬁ rst meeting. 3. According to the Article 243-T, seats shall be reserved for the SC and ST in every municipality and the number of seats so reserved shall bear, as nearly as may, the same proportion to the total number of seats to be ﬁ lled by direct election in that municipality as the population of the SC in the municipal area or of the ST in the municipal area bears to the total population of that area and such seats may be allotted by rotation to different constituencies in the municipality. 4. It is applicable in all states. Thus, statement 1, 2 & 3 are correct while 4 is incorrect.

questions.questionTextEn: What is correct about the recall of President of Municipal Council? i. The procedure of recall may be initiated with a proposal signed by 3/4 members of council. ii. The procedure of recall may be initiated with a proposal signed by 3/4 elected members of council. iii. If the council passed a resolution by majority, collector will take action. iv. President may be recalled by general voters with majority. v. President may be recalled by general voters with 2/3 majority. vi. The process of recall may be initiated once in his whole term. vii. The process of recall may be initiated twice in his whole term.
questions.questionTextHi: नगर परिषद के अध्यक्ष को वापस बुलाने के बारे में क्या सही है? मैं। वापस बुलाने की प्रक्रिया परिषद के 3/4 सदस्यों द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित प्रस्ताव के साथ शुरू की जा सकती है। द्वितीय. वापस बुलाने की प्रक्रिया परिषद के 3/4 निर्वाचित सदस्यों द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित प्रस्ताव के साथ शुरू की जा सकती है। iii. यदि परिषद ने बहुमत से प्रस्ताव पारित किया तो कलेक्टर कार्रवाई करेंगे। iv. राष्ट्रपति को आम मतदाताओं द्वारा बहुमत के साथ वापस बुलाया जा सकता है। v. राष्ट्रपति को आम मतदाताओं द्वारा 2/3 बहुमत के साथ वापस बुलाया जा सकता है। vi. उनके पूरे कार्यकाल में एक बार वापस बुलाने की प्रक्रिया शुरू की जा सकती है। सातवीं. उनके पूरे कार्यकाल में दो बार रिकॉल की प्रक्रिया शुरू की जा सकती है.
optionsEn: ii iv vii (e) None of the above
optionsHi: ii iv vii (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Section 47 of the Chhattisgarh Municipalities Act, 1961 provides for recall of the president of Municipal council.(1) Every President of a council shall be deemed to have vacated acted his ofﬁ ce if he is recalled through a secret ballot by a majority of more than half of the total number of voters of the municipal area casting the vote in accordance with the procedure as may be prescribed: Provided that no such process of recall shall be initiated unless a proposal is signed by not less than three fourth of the total number of the elected Councillors and presented to the Collector: Provided further that no such process shall be initiated: -- (i) within a period of two years from the date on which such President is elected and enters his ofﬁ ce; (ii) if half of the period of tenure of the President elected in a by-election has not expired: Provided also that process for recall of the President shall be initiated once in his whole term,. (2) the collector, after satisfying himself and verifying that the three fourth of the councillors speciﬁ ed in sub-section (1) have signed the proposal of recall, shall send the proposal to the State Government and the State Government shall make a reference to the State Election Commission. (3) On receipt of the reference, the State Election Commission shall arrange for voting on the proposal of recall in such manner as may be prescribed.

(2) the collector, after satisfying himself and verifying that the three fourth of the councillors speciﬁ ed in sub-section (1) have signed the proposal of recall, shall send the proposal to the State Government and the State Government shall make a reference to the State Election Commission. (3) On receipt of the reference, the State Election Commission shall arrange for voting on the proposal of recall in such manner as may be prescribed.

questions.questionTextEn: What is correct about the tenure of municipal council? i. The tenure of municipal council is counted from the date of declaration of election result. ii. The tenure of municipal council is counted from the date of its ﬁ rst meeting. iii. The tenure of municipal council is 5 years. iv. If municipal council is dissolved in two years, then new municipal council will be organised for three years. v. If municipal council is dissolved in two years then new municipal council will be organised for 5 years.
questions.questionTextHi: नगर पालिका परिषद के कार्यकाल के बारे में क्या सही है? मैं। नगर पालिका परिषद का कार्यकाल चुनाव परिणाम घोषित होने की तिथि से गिना जाता है। द्वितीय. नगरपालिका परिषद का कार्यकाल उसकी पहली बैठक की तारीख से गिना जाता है। iii. नगर पालिका परिषद का कार्यकाल 5 वर्ष का होता है। iv. यदि नगर परिषद दो वर्ष में भंग हो जाती है तो तीन वर्ष के लिए नई नगर परिषद गठित की जायेगी। v. यदि नगर परिषद दो वर्ष में भंग हो जाती है तो 5 वर्ष के लिए नई नगर परिषद गठित की जायेगी।
optionsEn: ii iii v (e) None of the above
optionsHi: ii iii v (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Duration of Municipal Council - A Corporation unless sooner dissolved, shall continue for 5 years from the date appointed for its ﬁ rst meeting & no longer. Hence statement (i) is wrong (ii) & (iii) are correct. An election to constitute a Corporation shall be completed (a) before the expiry of its duration speciﬁ ed. (b) before the expiration of a period of six months from the date of its dissolutions. Provided that where the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Corporation would have continued is less than six months, it shall not be necessary to hold any election A Corporation constituted upon its dissolution before the expiration of its duration shall continue only for the remainder of the period. Hence statement (iv) is correct & (v) is wrong.

questions.questionTextEn: If a Panchayat is dissolved, elections are to be held within–
questions.questionTextHi: यदि कोई पंचायत भंग हो जाती है, तो चुनाव कहाँ कराये जायेंगे?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). According to Article 243E, unless sooner dissolved under any law for the time being in force, Panchayats shall continue for five years from the date appointed. If Panchayat is dissolved, the election is to be held before the expiration of 6 months from the date of dissolution provided that where the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayats would have continued is less than 6 months, it shall not be necessary to hold any election for constituting Panchayat for such period.

According to Article 243E, unless sooner dissolved under any law for the time being in force, Panchayats shall continue for five years from the date appointed. If Panchayat is dissolved, the election is to be held before the expiration of 6 months from the date of dissolution provided that where the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayats would have continued is less than 6 months, it shall not be necessary to hold any election for constituting Panchayat for such period.
questions.explanation_hi: सही उत्तर: (C) According to Article 243E, unless sooner dissolved under any law for the time being in force, Panchayats shall continue for five years from the date appointed. If Panchayat is dissolved, the election is to be held before the expiration of 6 months from the date of dissolution provided that where the remainder of the period for which the dissolved Panchayats would have continued is less than 6 months, it shall not be necessary to hold any election for constituting Panchayat for such period.

questions.questionTextEn: With reference to the Consumer Disputes Redressal at the district level in India, which one of the following statements is not correct?
questions.questionTextHi: भारत में जिला स्तर पर उपभोक्ता विवाद निवारण के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही नहीं है?
optionsEn: State Government can establish more than one District Forum in a district if it deems ﬁ t.
One of the members of the District Forum shall be a woman.
The District Forum entertains the complaints where the value of goods or services does not exceed rupees ﬁ fty lakhs.
A complaint in relation to any goods sold or any service provided may be ﬁ led with a District Forum by the State Government as a representative of the interest of the consumers in general.
optionsHi: राज्य सरकार यदि उचित समझे तो एक जिले में एक से अधिक जिला फोरम स्थापित कर सकती है।
जिला फोरम के सदस्यों में से एक महिला होगी।
जिला फोरम उन शिकायतों पर विचार करता है जहां वस्तुओं या सेवाओं का मूल्य पचास लाख रुपये से अधिक नहीं है।
बेचे गए किसी भी सामान या प्रदान की गई किसी भी सेवा के संबंध में शिकायत सामान्य रूप से उपभोक्ताओं के हित के प्रतिनिधि के रूप में राज्य सरकार द्वारा जिला फोरम में दायर की जा सकती है।
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). Under the Consumer Protection Act of 1986, the State Government shall establish a District Forum in each district of the State, and The District Forum shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services and the compensation, if any, claimed does not exceed rupees twenty lakhs, whereas in the case of State Commission claimed exceeds rupees twenty lakhs but does not exceed rupees one crore. A State Government can ﬁ le a case in a District Forum for the sake of consumer interest.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) Under the Consumer Protection Act of 1986, the State Government shall establish a District Forum in each district of the State, and The District Forum shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services and the compensation, if any, claimed does not exceed rupees twenty lakhs, whereas in the case of State Commission claimed exceeds rupees twenty lakhs but does not exceed rupees one crore. A State Government can ﬁ le a case in a District Forum for the sake of consumer interest.

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following criteria for deciding an urban area, according to Census of India, is not correct? All places with:
questions.questionTextHi: भारत की जनगणना के अनुसार शहरी क्षेत्र तय करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मानदंड सही नहीं है? सभी स्थानों के साथ:
optionsEn: Either a Municipality or Corporation or Cantonment or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee.
At least 60% of the male population engaged in non- agricultural pursuits.
A density of population of at least 400 persons per square km.
optionsHi: या तो नगर पालिका या निगम या छावनी या अधिसूचित टाउन एरिया समिति।
कम से कम 60% पुरुष आबादी गैर-कृषि कार्यों में लगी हुई है।
जनसंख्या का घनत्व कम से कम 400 व्यक्ति प्रति वर्ग किमी.
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). All the areas, which include Municipality, Municipal Corporation, Cantonment Board or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee come under urban area if the following three conditions are satisﬁ ed- (1) There must be a minimum population of 5000. (2) A Minimum 75% of working men are engaged in non-agricultural activities, and (3) ‘Population density’ must be at least 400 people per square kilometer.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) All the areas, which include Municipality, Municipal Corporation, Cantonment Board or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee come under urban area if the following three conditions are satisﬁ ed- (1) There must be a minimum population of 5000. questions.question_hi: भारत की जनगणना के अनुसार शहरी क्षेत्र तय करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मानदंड सही नहीं है? सभी स्थानों के साथ:
options_en: Either a Municipality or Corporation or Cantonment or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee.
At least 60% of the male population engaged in non- agricultural pursuits.
A density of population of at least 400 persons per square km.
options_hi: या तो नगर पालिका या निगम या छावनी या अधिसूचित टाउन एरिया समिति।
कम से कम 60% पुरुष आबादी गैर-कृषि कार्यों में लगी हुई है।
जनसंख्या का घनत्व कम से कम 400 व्यक्ति प्रति वर्ग किमी.
questions.explanation_en: Correct Answer: (C). All the areas, which include Municipality, Municipal Corporation, Cantonment Board or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee come under urban area if the following three conditions are satisﬁ ed- (1) There must be a minimum population of 5000. (2) A Minimum 75% of working men are engaged in non-agricultural activities, and (3) ‘Population density’ must be at least 400 people per square kilometer.
questions.explanation_hi: सही उत्तर: (C) All the areas, which include Municipality, Municipal Corporation, Cantonment Board or Notiﬁ ed Town Area Committee come under urban area if the following three conditions are satisﬁ ed- (1) There must be a minimum population of 5000. (2) A Minimum 75% of working men are engaged in non-agricultural activities, and (3) ‘Population density’ must be at least 400 people per square kilometer.

questions.questionTextEn: Consider the following statements: In India, a Metropolitan Planning Committee – 1. is constituted under the provisions of the Constitution of India. 2. prepares the draft development plans for the metropolitan area. 3. has the sole responsibility for implementing Government sponsored schemes in the metropolitan area. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: भारत में, एक महानगरीय योजना समिति - 1. का गठन भारत के संविधान के प्रावधानों के तहत किया जाता है। 2. महानगरीय क्षेत्र के लिए विकास योजनाओं का मसौदा तैयार करता है। 3. महानगरीय क्षेत्र में सरकार प्रायोजित योजनाओं को लागू करने की एकमात्र जिम्मेदारी है। ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). According to Article 243-ZE a Metropolitan Planning Committee is constituted in every metropolitan area to prepare a draft development for the metropolitan area. Although it’s responsibility is limited to sending the draft development plans to the state government.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (A) According to Article 243-ZE a Metropolitan Planning Committee is constituted in every metropolitan area to prepare a draft development for the metropolitan area. Although it’s responsibility is limited to sending the draft development plans to the state government.

questions.questionTextHi: भारत में प्रत्येक पंचायत का कार्यकाल पाँच वर्ष होता है-
optionsEn: The scheduled date of its ﬁ rst meeting
The date of notiﬁ cation of election.
The date of declaration of election results.
The date of oath of ofﬁ ce by members.
optionsHi: इसकी पहली बैठक की निर्धारित तिथि
चुनाव परिणाम घोषित होने की तिथि.
सदस्यों द्वारा पद की शपथ की तिथि.
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A). According to Article 243E, every Panchayat shall continue for ﬁ ve years from the date appointed for its ﬁ rst meeting, unless sooner dissolved, under any law for the time being in force. In the case where the Panchayat dissolved before the completion of ﬁ ve years, the election to constitute a Panchayat shall be completed before the expiration of six months from the date of its dissolution.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (A) According to Article 243E, every Panchayat shall continue for ﬁ ve years from the date appointed for its ﬁ rst meeting, unless sooner dissolved, under any law for the time being in force. questions.questionTextEn: Election was held on 20 January, 2014 for a Gram Panchayat. Its ﬁ rst meeting was called on 10 Febru- ary 2014. Thereafter Gram Panchayat was dissolved on 20th February, 2016. Election was held on 15th May, 2016 for New Gram Panchayat and, its ﬁ rst meeting was called on 25th May, 2016. What shall be tenure of the new constituted Gram Panchayat?
questions.questionTextHi: ग्राम पंचायत के लिए 20 जनवरी 2014 को चुनाव हुआ था. इसकी पहली बैठक 10 फरवरी 2014 को बुलाई गई थी। इसके बाद 20 फरवरी 2016 को ग्राम पंचायत को भंग कर दिया गया था। नई ग्राम पंचायत के लिए 15 मई 2016 को चुनाव हुआ था और इसकी पहली बैठक 25 मई 2016 को बुलाई गई थी। नई गठित ग्राम पंचायत का कार्यकाल क्या होगा?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). 73rd Amendment act of 1992, provides for a ﬁ ve-year term ofﬁ ce to the panchayat at every level. However, it can be dissolved before the completion of its term. Moreover, a Panchayat constituted upon the dissolution of a panchayat before the expiration of its duration shall continue only for the remainder of the period for which the dissolved panchayat would have continued if it had been the case.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (B) 73rd Amendment act of 1992, provides for a ﬁ ve-year term ofﬁ ce to the panchayat at every level. However, it can be dissolved before the completion of its term. Moreover, a Panchayat constituted upon the dissolution of a panchayat before the expiration of its duration shall continue only for the remainder of the period for which the dissolved panchayat would have continued if it had been the case.

optionsEn: The Legislature of a State may by law make provision with respect to the composition of Panchayat.
A Gram Sabha shall exercise it’s powers at the village level.
Each State will constitute Panchayat at the village, intermediate and district level.
Panchayat at the intermediate level shall not be constituted in a State having a population not exceeding twenty lakhs.
optionsHi: किसी राज्य का विधानमंडल कानून द्वारा पंचायत की संरचना के संबंध में प्रावधान कर सकता है।
ग्राम सभा ग्राम स्तर पर अपनी शक्तियों का प्रयोग करेगी।
प्रत्येक राज्य ग्राम, मध्यवर्ती और जिला स्तर पर पंचायत का गठन करेगा।

Thus statement (a), (b) and (d) are correct and (c) is wrong. Therefore (c) is not correct among given statements.

optionsEn: Adult members of only the scheduled caste and scheduled tribe households
Adult members of Below Poverty Line (BPL) households
Adult members of households of all backward communities
optionsHi: केवल अनुसूचित जाति और अनुसूचित जनजाति के परिवारों के वयस्क सदस्य

सभी पिछड़े समुदायों के घरों के वयस्क सदस्य

questions.questionTextHi: सामुदायिक विकास कार्यक्रमों का उद्देश्य क्या है?
optionsEn: Helping villages in planning (e) None of the above/More than one of the above
optionsHi: गांवों को योजना बनाने में मदद करना (ई) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं/उपरोक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (E). Objectives of Community Development Programme are : (i) To assist each village in having effective Panchayats cooperatives and schools; (ii) Through these village institutions, plan and carry out integrated multi-phased family, village, Block and District. (a) Increasing agricultural Production. (b) Improving existing village crafts and industries and organising new ones. (c) Providing minimum essential health services and improv- ing health practices. (d) Providing required educational facilities for children and an adult education programme. (e) Providing recreational facilities and programmes. (f) Improving housing and family living conditions, and (g) Providing programmes for village women and youth. More than one of the given option is correct. So, the correct answer is (e). Special Provision for Certain Class *The special provisions relating to certain classes are contained in part XVI of the constitution from article 330 to 342. *Article 330 provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the house of the people. *Under Article 331, provision was made for the representation of the Anglo-Indian community in the House of the people. It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating representatives of the Anglo-Indian Community in the House of the People have not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by 'The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019. *Article 332 provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the legislative assemblies of the states. *Under Article 333, provision was made for the representation of the Anglo-Indian Community in the Legislative Assemblies of the States. It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating representatives of the Anglo-Indian Community in the Legislative Assemblies of the states have not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by 'The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019. *Article 338 provides for provisions relating to the National commission for SCs. *At present Vijay Sampla is the chairman of this commission. *Article 338A was added by the 89th constitutional amendment act 2003 which provides for a separate National commission for STs. *The President can appoint a commission to investigate the condition of backward classes (Article 340). *The president can declares any caste of a state/U.T. as a scheduled caste consulting with the Governor/Lt. Governor of that state/UT (article 341(1)). *The president can declare any caste of a state/UT as a scheduled tribe in consulting with the governor/Lt. governor of that state/UT [article 342(1)]. Note : The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019 provides for increasing the reservation of seats
